description: This PHP source file defines the Node class implementing a nested set model node for hierarchical structures, including methods for traversal, insertion, deletion, and hierarchy management within an ORM context.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Implements nested set model node with hierarchy operations such as adding, removing, and retrieving parent/children nodes within ORM-based persistence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Node with a given NestedSetInterface entity.

methods.name: getLeftValue
methods.description: Retrieves the left value of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: getRightValue
methods.description: Retrieves the right value of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Determines if the node has child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical level of the node.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts the left and right values of nodes to accommodate new insertions or deletions.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists the node with specified left and right values.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Determines if the node is a leaf (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its subnodes from the hierarchy.
